crop_resize_image_with_intrinsics: use crop_resize_if_necessary to downscale and crop an image with depthmap and camera intrinsics to a target resolution
rescale_image_with_depthmap: use rescale_image_and_other_optional_info to rescale an image with its depthmap and camera intrinsics to a target resolution
crop_image_with_bbox: use crop_image_and_other_optional_info to crop an image with depthmap and camera intrinsics using a bounding box
resize_map_to_aspect_ratio: use resize_with_nearest_interpolation_to_match_aspect_ratio to resize a map with nearest interpolation to match an image aspect ratio
compute_crop_camera_matrix: use camera_matrix_of_crop to calculate the updated camera intrinsics matrix for a cropped and scaled image
